rows.composition: One gingerbread cookie character striding with one tall red-and-white candy cane like a walking staff.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: tall narrow cookie body, oval head, smiling crescent icing eyes, green icing vest with tiny gold dots, red bow tie, long bent legs
rows.actualComposition: A tall oval-headed cookie holds one complete red-and-white candy cane. Green vest piping, gold buttons and scalloped white ankle icing decorate the long-limbed figure.

rows.composition: One tiny gingerbread character peeking over the rim of a complete open clear cookie jar with two star cookies inside and a checked ribbon around the neck.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: round head, chocolate bead eyes, one arched white eyebrow, scalloped white icing fringe, short plump body, curious open mouth
rows.actualComposition: A clear open jar contains two distinct star-shaped cookies with icing snowflake details. The small character grips the upper rim above a red-and-white checked ribbon and bow.

rows.composition: One broad laughing gingerbread character seated on a complete little peppermint-red sled, both cookie arms raised.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: square-rounded head, asymmetrical icing grin, dark chocolate baked edges, blue sugar-knit cap, cream icing scarf, short broad legs
rows.actualComposition: The red sled has two complete curved striped runners and gold-colored fastenings. The broad cookie face has a large open smile, red cheeks and white icing fringe beneath a blue cap.

rows.composition: One seated gingerbread girl hugging a single large red heart cookie.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: small pear head, dotted icing freckles, tiny closed smile, long piped icing braid, lavender scalloped skirt, squat seated silhouette
rows.actualComposition: A seated cookie figure holds one red heart with scalloped white icing and a tiny white heart. The purple skirt, piped braid and floral hair decorations distinguish the character.

rows.composition: One gingerbread cookie courier putting a blank envelope into a tiny green mailbox on a candy-striped post.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: long hexagonal-soft head, close-set chocolate eyes, one curved eyebrow, burgundy icing cape, blue satchel, thin body and long feet
rows.actualComposition: One extended cookie hand touches a cream envelope with a red seal at the open green mailbox. The tall narrow character has a pointed-sided head, short icing smile and blue shoulder satchel.

rows.composition: One small gingerbread figure holding a complete gold star-shaped lantern on a loop beside its body.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: large teardrop head, wide oval eyes, pursed curious icing mouth, teal pointed nightcap, gold piping on a navy icing coat, broad pear torso
rows.actualComposition: A complete five-point gold lantern hangs from a small loop beside the figure. The teal floppy cap has gold stars, and the navy coat has gold piping and round buttons.

rows.composition: One excited gingerbread character riding a horizontal complete wooden rolling pin like a hobby horse.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: flat round head, slanted happy eyes, scalloped icing moustache, red bandana, two mint candy buttons, one raised cookie arm
rows.actualComposition: A complete wooden rolling pin runs horizontally beneath the seated cookie figure. A large white icing moustache and closed laughing eyes distinguish the round face.

rows.composition: One gingerbread reader seated on a single thick closed red book and holding an open green book with blank pages.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: heart-shaped head, round candy spectacles, shy small mouth, cream icing collar, narrow torso and two short splayed feet
rows.actualComposition: The head itself is heart-shaped and edged with a double white icing border. Round peppermint-striped spectacles sit above an open green book, with a closed red book below.

rows.composition: One gingerbread dancer balancing on one pointed cookie foot, hands curved above head, wearing a snowflake-edged icing skirt.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: small diamond-rounded face, closed icing eyelids, pink candy crown, pale aqua layered skirt, long tapered limbs
rows.actualComposition: The extended cookie arms curve above a small crowned head with closed eyes. One leg supports the figure while the other bends behind an aqua layered snowflake skirt.

rows.composition: One mischievous gingerbread character sitting on the rim of a complete cream cocoa mug, dipping just one cookie toe toward the drink.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: wide round head, raised eyebrow, red icing scarf, little white knee dots, green candy buttons, short bent legs
rows.actualComposition: The cookie character’s lower legs enter the brown cocoa inside a full cream mug. Red piping, green holly leaves and berries decorate the mug beneath its complete handle.

rows.composition: One gingerbread drummer holding two sticks over a single round peppermint drum on a shoulder strap.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: long oval face, open laughing mouth, tiny blue beret, red-and-white sugar sash, slim tapered body, white icing ankle cuffs
rows.actualComposition: Two wooden sticks with red tips are held at different heights above the drum. A small blue beret and long oval face sit above two peppermint buttons and a striped drum strap.

rows.composition: One gingerbread gardener kneeling beside a small pot of peppermint-leaf-shaped icing sprouts, holding a tiny watering can.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: broad rounded face, dotted chocolate eyes, sweet curved smile, green scalloped bonnet, mustard icing overalls, thick bent knees
rows.actualComposition: A tilted green watering can releases a few blue drops toward striped red-and-green leaf shapes. The gardener kneels in mustard overalls beneath a scalloped green floral bonnet.

rows.composition: One gingerbread gymnast sweeping one complete rainbow ribbon in a single wide loop with a short wand.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: narrow heart face, large focused eyes, purple sugar bow, yellow icing leotard, long curved limbs, dynamic tilted pose
rows.actualComposition: One short wand held in an extended cookie arm connects to a complete rainbow ribbon loop. The yellow icing outfit has white swirls, and one long leg stretches diagonally outward.

rows.composition: One dignified gingerbread king holding a short striped candy scepter, seated on a tiny complete gumdrop throne.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: square cookie head, chocolate brows, piped white moustache, small gold icing crown, emerald cape with cream edging, sturdy short body
rows.actualComposition: A complete throne has gumdrop armrests and a tall red candy back behind the crowned figure. The square cookie face has dark raised brows, white moustache and beard, and a red candy nose.

rows.composition: Two distinct gingerbread heads peeking around opposite sides of one complete empty arched icing window frame.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: left broad round face with red cap and dot eyes, right narrow oval face with green bow and closed smile, separate white piping patterns
rows.actualComposition: The complete thick arch has white icing curls and a blank open center. Two distinct cookie figures hold opposite sides, one open-eyed in a red cap and one closed-eyed with a green bow.

rows.composition: Three gingerbread characters holding hands in an arched family grouping, each complete and different.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: tall slender figure with teal vest and crescent eyes, broad skirted figure with pink bonnet and dot smile, tiny round child with green suspenders
rows.actualComposition: Three full cookie bodies form one hand-holding group with a smaller figure in the center. The teal vest, green suspenders and pink apron dress have distinct icing cuts and details.

rows.composition: One tiny gingerbread character leaning around the bottom right of a large complete blank cream recipe card with a thin brown border.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: oval head, oversized gentle eyes, white scalloped headband, red gingham icing apron without chef hat or whisk, plump rounded limbs
rows.actualComposition: A complete horizontal cream rectangle with rounded corners and double brown border contains no writing. A cookie figure with a gingham apron and white scalloped headband leans around the right edge.

rows.composition: One gingerbread astronomer looking into a small complete brass telescope on a three-legged wafer tripod.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: round face with one eye closed at eyepiece, navy icing pointed cap with white dots, violet short cape, tall slim cookie body
rows.actualComposition: A brass telescope sits on three complete waffle-textured legs with dark rounded feet. The navy pointed cap has stars and dots, and white star piping decorates the purple cape.

rows.composition: One joyful gingerbread cookie child holding the string of one red heart balloon, feet slightly lifted in a playful airborne pose.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: oversized broad head, two big chocolate eyes, tiny white open smile, yellow bow, mint icing shorts, short curved arms
rows.actualComposition: A full red heart balloon is connected by a visible pale string to the raised cookie hand. The small figure wears mint scalloped shorts with heart details and a large yellow bow.

rows.composition: One gingerbread character pushing a small complete red wheelbarrow carrying two differently shaped gift boxes.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: small triangular-rounded face, orange icing cap, teal dotted waistcoat, three white buttons, long forward-leaning body
rows.actualComposition: A single-wheeled red barrow carries one tall striped gift and one smaller green gift. The character has a triangular-rounded head, orange icing cap and teal waistcoat edged with white dots.

rows.composition: One complete original dog-shaped gingerbread cookie with floppy icing ears, brown candy nose, pink tongue and mint collar.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: low rounded puppy silhouette, one raised paw, long curved tail, white piped outline, baked amber center
rows.actualComposition: One seated puppy cookie lifts its front paw, revealing four icing toe dots and a central paw pad. A green collar with a peppermint medallion and full curved tail complete the single cookie silhouette.

rows.composition: One complete original sleeping cat-shaped gingerbread cookie curled into a crescent with tail around paws.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: pointed cookie ears, closed white icing eyes, little pink nose, dark cocoa stripe piping, tiny red bow collar
rows.actualComposition: One curled cat cookie has a complete oval body and a tail wrapping across the front. Chocolate icing stripes, a pink nose and closed white eyelids define the sleeping face.

rows.composition: One complete seated fox-shaped gingerbread cookie with a broad bushy tail curling alongside its body.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: triangular face, white icing muzzle and tail tip, orange-brown baked center, two dark chocolate eyes, one green holly accent
rows.actualComposition: The single fox cookie has pointed ears, a triangular white muzzle and a large curved tail. Green holly leaves and three red berries sit beside the upper right side of the head.

rows.composition: One complete round owl-shaped gingerbread cookie perched on a short icing branch.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: large pale mint icing eye rings, almond cookie wings with white scallops, orange candy beak, small rounded ears
rows.actualComposition: Two pale green scalloped eye rings surround large brown eyes on one complete owl cookie. White icing scallops fill the wings and belly above a short branch with green leaf decorations.

rows.composition: One complete side-view hedgehog-shaped gingerbread cookie with decorative chocolate-icing spines and a small apple beside its nose.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: low teardrop silhouette, pointed white-icing muzzle, one black eye, tiny rounded feet, red apple accent
rows.actualComposition: One low hedgehog cookie has a pointed cream face and dark chocolate spines across its back. A separate small red apple with a green leaf touches the area in front of the nose.

rows.composition: One complete reindeer-head gingerbread cookie with two intact branched cookie antlers and a small green bow at its neck.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: long narrow muzzle, round chocolate nose not red, almond icing eyes, cream forehead diamond, brown baked antlers
rows.actualComposition: One complete cookie head includes two broad branched antlers and cream-centered ears. A green bow sits beneath the long muzzle, and the forehead has a white diamond with tiny icing dots.

rows.composition: Two different complete mitten-shaped gingerbread cookies joined by one loose red icing cord, one patterned with a star and one with chevrons.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: asymmetrical mitten positions, thick baked edges, forest green and ivory piped panels, no duplicate template
rows.actualComposition: Two distinct mitten bodies have small faces and attached rounded cookie legs. One mitten has a green star and open eyes; the other has chevron bands and closed laughing eyes.

rows.composition: One complete six-armed gingerbread snowflake cookie with an intricate white royal-icing lace pattern and a pale blue candy center.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: six equal radial arms, sturdy edible bridges, tiny white icing pearls and crisp amber edges
rows.actualComposition: Six complete radial cookie arms form one intact snowflake silhouette. White droplet and dot piping surround a small round pale blue center candy.

rows.composition: One complete tall fir-tree-shaped gingerbread cookie decorated with zigzag green icing, red berries and a small gold sugar star.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: five irregular branch tiers, brown trunk, deep baked cookie silhouette, wide trunk-to-tip difference
rows.actualComposition: One complete tiered fir-shaped cookie has a brown rectangular trunk. Green icing loops and red round candies cross the tree beneath a gold-edged star.

rows.composition: One complete bell-shaped gingerbread cookie with white filigree icing, a red ribbon bow and a small round candy clapper.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: wide flared bell body, brown baked perimeter, green holly icing at top, subtle gold sugar dots
rows.actualComposition: The complete bell silhouette has a wide flared lower edge and one hanging round red clapper. A large red ribbon bow and holly leaves sit above symmetrical white icing curls.

rows.composition: One complete stocking-shaped gingerbread cookie with a thick cream icing cuff, red crosshatch icing and one tiny wrapped-candy decoration.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: long bent foot, tilted top edge, dark baked border, three mint candy buttons on cuff
rows.actualComposition: One complete bent stocking silhouette has red grid icing over its brown cookie body. Three green peppermint candies sit across the thick cream cuff above a small candy-shaped decoration.

rows.composition: One complete rocking-horse-shaped gingerbread cookie with a turquoise icing saddle and white mane piping.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: four supported cookie legs, curved connected rocker, small rounded ears and brown candy eye
rows.actualComposition: A single horse-shaped cookie connects to a complete curved rocking base with white scroll piping. The turquoise scalloped saddle has a central icing snowflake and white candy pearls.

rows.composition: One complete little gingerbread cottage with ONE round tower, conical candy roof, arched green door and snowy white icing seams.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: tower-and-low-wing silhouette, raspberry candy roof tiles, two oval windows, small gumdrops at foundation, no character
rows.actualComposition: The building combines one round tall tower with a low pitched-roof wing and small chimney. Pink overlapping roof scallops, a green door and three round amber windows distinguish the cottage.

rows.composition: One complete steep A-frame gingerbread chalet with almond-shingle roof, amber sugar window and teal candy door.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: triangular compact facade, thick white roof icing, striped candy posts and one star cookie above door, no character
rows.actualComposition: A triangular roof with tan overlapping shingles rises over three amber windows and a teal arched door. A small wreath, red-and-green candy dots and two striped columns decorate the compact front.

rows.composition: One complete whimsical gingerbread windmill with four intact wafer sails attached to a central candy hub.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: narrow tapered biscuit tower, green icing door, round peppermint window, cream scalloped roof edge, no background
rows.actualComposition: Four complete rectangular wafer sails cross around a round peppermint hub. A tapered biscuit tower has a circular sugar window, green door and white scroll icing.

rows.composition: One complete gingerbread lighthouse with stacked red icing bands and a small round sugar-glass lantern room.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: tall tapered tower on small round cookie base, chocolate rail around lantern, striped peppermint cap, no landscape
rows.actualComposition: A full tapered lighthouse stands on a round cookie foundation with a small brown door. The upper glass-like amber room has dark railing and a red-and-white striped roof with a round finial.

rows.composition: One complete gingerbread toy locomotive with an attached single small wagon carrying striped candy sticks.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: rectangular biscuit cab, round gumdrop wheels attached to chassis, candy chimney, ivory seams and teal roof
rows.actualComposition: A complete locomotive and one wagon connect through a visible red coupling. Peppermint wheels, a candy-striped chimney and a teal scalloped roof distinguish the train.

rows.composition: One complete side-view gingerbread camper trailer with two peppermint wheels, arched candy door and striped icing awning.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: rounded box silhouette, red candy roof trim, two sugar windows, visible small tow hitch, no scenery
rows.actualComposition: The complete trailer has two visible round peppermint wheels, one door and a tow bar extending right. Red-and-white striped awnings sit above two amber windows beside the central door.

rows.composition: One complete tiny gingerbread carousel with three distinct cookie animals suspended beneath a scalloped candy canopy.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: six-sided biscuit base, gold central post, red-and-green canopy segments, clearly supported animals and whole top finial
rows.actualComposition: Three distinct animals occupy the carousel: a spotted reindeer, white-maned horse and scarf-wearing bear. A complete scalloped canopy, central gold post and round biscuit platform frame the animals.

rows.composition: One complete whimsical teapot constructed visually from gingerbread with a white icing lid, curved cookie spout and full open handle.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: round baked-biscuit body, pink icing floral medallion, tiny green leaves and clear amber cookie edges
rows.actualComposition: One complete teapot silhouette has a separate-looking lid, open curved handle and long raised spout. A large pink icing flower and green leaves decorate the rounded brown biscuit body.

rows.composition: One complete heart-shaped gift box filled with four individually patterned gingerbread cookies, lid leaning behind with a red bow.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: cream box rim, star tree small heart and round face cookies, no duplicates, simple clean arrangement
rows.actualComposition: Four different cookie silhouettes occupy the heart-shaped tray in separate paper liners. A matching heart lid leans behind the box with a large red bow and tiny red heart border.

rows.composition: One compact complete gingerbread decorating arrangement: plain star biscuit, one piping bag with white icing touching its edge and two small colored icing bowls.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: top-down still life, three separate tools with coherent tips and bowl rims, no human hands or text
rows.actualComposition: A full five-point cookie has a continuous white border meeting a metal piping tip. A complete white piping bag and two small round bowls of red and green icing sit beside the star.

rows.composition: One complete small rolled gingerbread dough sheet with an empty star cutout and one shiny metal star cutter beside it.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: irregular oval dough edge, scattered tiny flour specks contained on dough, cutter clearly hollow, no tabletop backdrop
rows.actualComposition: A complete hollow metal star cutter rests beside a matching star-shaped hole in the dough. The dough sheet has a softly uneven oval perimeter and small contained white flour specks.

rows.composition: One complete ring wreath made from alternating gingerbread stars, hearts and tiny houses with ivory icing and a large sage ribbon bow.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: open center, varied cookie silhouettes, no person cookie, coherent overlapping cookies and full ribbon tails
rows.actualComposition: Three different cookie shapes form a complete ring with a clear open center. A large green ribbon bow, holly leaves and red berries join the individually piped cookies.

rows.composition: Original cheerful lettering reading exactly SWEET HOLIDAYS, formed from baked gingerbread letters with white icing outlines and one small star cookie.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: two compact rows, brown raised cookie edges, red and green candy dot accents, no character
rows.actualComposition: The complete exact words SWEET HOLIDAYS appear in two rows of brown cookie letters. Each letter has icing and candy details, and a small star cookie sits beside the final T.

rows.composition: BLACK AND WHITE original coloring composition: one gingerbread character flying a single star-shaped kite with a complete bow-tailed string.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: large oval head, tiny closed smile, striped candy cap, three heart buttons, one raised arm and bent legs
rows.actualComposition: A complete five-point star kite connects through a curved string with three bows to the raised hand. The rounded cookie figure has closed happy eyes, a striped cap and three heart-shaped chest decorations.

rows.composition: BLACK AND WHITE original coloring composition: an open storybook with one little gingerbread castle rising as a paper pop-up, no character.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: two unequal towers, icing battlements, candy gate, clear folded page base and whole book corners
rows.actualComposition: One complete open book supports a castle with two unequal towers and a central double door. Peppermint finials, heart decorations and striped columns define the edible castle details.

rows.composition: BLACK AND WHITE original coloring composition: one long-legged gingerbread character riding a small bicycle with two full peppermint-spoked wheels.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: narrow cookie head, big smile, rounded cap, dotted waistcoat, two connected arms on handlebars and both feet at pedals
rows.actualComposition: The bicycle has two complete round wheels, a connected frame, saddle and handlebars. The long-faced smiling character wears a cap, bow tie and dotted icing vest.

rows.composition: BLACK AND WHITE original coloring composition: two very different small gingerbread figures holding opposite ends of one complete blank ribbon banner.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: left short round face with bow tie, right tall oval face with bonnet, distinct icing piping and bodies, open banner center
rows.actualComposition: Two complete cookie figures hold the opposite upper ends of one full blank ribbon. The left figure has a round head and bow tie; the taller right figure wears a bonnet and layered skirt.

rows.composition: One complete baking tray holding five different gingerbread cookie shapes in a loose row: heart, star, tree, bell and house, no letters or numbers.
rows.characterDesignMatrix: shallow teal pan with visible full handles, each cookie a unique outline with restrained white piping, top-down view
rows.actualComposition: Exactly five distinct cookie silhouettes line the complete teal tray. Each cookie has a different icing pattern and expression; no numbers or words are printed.

actualCollectionReview.result: 50 complete independent compositions actually viewed: cookie characters with different face silhouettes, icing clothes, proportions and poses; animal cookies, edible-style buildings and objects, a greeting and four independent outline scenes. Existing chef, plain figure, dancing pair and elf-house concepts excluded. Versions and exports are not new artwork.
